decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01; 02; 03; 04; 05; 06; Design and Access Statement; Received 18/01/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby approved shall not operate outside of the following hours Monday to Friday 08:00-20:00, Saturdays 08:00 - 18:00 and 10:00-16:00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The first floor of the premises shall only be used for D1 educational use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1  of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Change of use from  B1 Office use to Mixed B1 Office and D1 Education / Training Centre
